about: Every automation element of FilmCraft and every menu command: where it is (panel), how to make it visible from a fresh start (reach), what a click did on the demo project (effect) and the engine command behind it (command). Generated by the UI crawler (crates/ui-egui/tests/ui_map_crawl.rs); do not edit by hand.

reachSyntax.command_run <command> <params>: command_run; <…> names something to pick, e.g. a clip id from sequence_inspect
reachSyntax.ui.click <id>: ui_click {id}; `button=right` is a right-click. {clip}, {item}, {track}, {name}… stand for a real id from ui_elements
reachSyntax.ui.menu.invoke <command>: command_run {id: command} (opens the command's dialog, as the menu does)
